blocks.content: Quiz: In C, we use ______() to display text on the screen.
Tap an option below to answer:
print
Incorrect, give it another shot!
This might sound correct, but C does not have a command called print().
This might sound correct, but C does not have a command called print().
printf
Correct Answer!
C uses the printf() command to display text on the screen. It shows the text exactly as we write it inside the double quotes.
C uses the printf() command to display text on the screen. It shows the text exactly as we write it inside the double quotes.
show
Incorrect, give it another shot!
Even though "show" means to display something, C does not recognize show() as a valid way to do that.
Even though "show" means to display something, C does not recognize show() as a valid way to do that.
display
Incorrect, give it another shot!
This word makes sense in English, but C does not use display() to put text on the screen.
